title: Action-level impact of adversarial logs on SOC agents
hypothesis: Attacker-controlled log text can cause a SOC agent to suppress a seeded incident or execute forbidden mock remediation even when its output conforms to a required schema.
null_hypothesis: Adversarial log fields do not alter protected handling beyond factual event content and pre-registered baseline variability.
novelty_review: known-class local mechanism study; exhaustive survey pending

tool.name: SOC-agent adversarial regression suite
tool.status: local prototype implemented; production adapter pending

local_hypothesis: A schema-valid but unauthorized candidate action can change incident state unless an independent action policy rejects it.
hypothesis_evaluation: Downstream action control supported; LLM log-to-action susceptibility not evaluated.
